openFindings.finding: At 844x390, all on-screen steering/braking/throttle/boost controls are absent in both quality presets and all captured play states, including on a touch-capable emulated context. The touch region is display:none with zero bounds. The CSS enables its display only at max-width:760px, so rotating a phone beyond that width removes the driving controls.
openFindings.reproduction: Touch-capable 390x844 context, rotate/set viewport to 844x390; enter any racing scenario. No on-screen drive controls remain.
openFindings.fix: Make the existing touch control row available in the supported touch landscape layout without requiring a width under 761px. Preserve non-overlapping notice/map/telemetry regions and verify pointer input/release after rotation.
openFindings.implementation: Responsive correction committed; scoped affected-view verification pending. Accepted art and camera unchanged.

openFindings.finding: At 390x844 during deliberate impact, reserve text and speed cover substantial portions of the banked craft, and the full-width impact notice crosses its rear/engines. At 640x360 the impact notice also crosses the craft. DOM regions are disjoint, so the automatic rectangle audit misses this world-space overlap. The road remains visible and the craft is not cropped by the viewport; this is an overlay placement/framing issue.
openFindings.reproduction: At 390x844 or640x360 load impact, hold actual w+d for approximately1.2s, release and capture. Both high and low show the interference. Portrait screenshots are near1.35s because setup/capture takes real frames.
openFindings.fix: Reserve a clear impact-notice band away from the visible craft and keep essential reserve/speed legible during banked contact. A responsive notice placement and/or opt-in safe-frame adjustment is sufficient; leave accepted desktop art unchanged. Check review open/closed and one ordinary crown view to avoid moving the collision elsewhere.
